set.body: Acceptance criteria: canonical I-VT, I-DT, and Engbert-Kliegl each name a citation, implementation version, assumptions, deviations, and designated reference; pinned independent fixtures cover hand-computable and reference cases; synthetic trajectories cover fixation, saccade, blink, loss, off-screen data, noise, jitter, dropout, and clock drift; metamorphic tests cover translation, rotation, coherent spatial scaling, time scaling, and arbitrary streaming chunks; results report class-wise timing and physical-velocity errors; targeted scale, gap, boundary, and vacuity mutants fail; representative results agree on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Build the detector scientific validation court
